evidenceNote: Network DNS resolution failed in this execution environment. Entries are discovery candidates, not live-verified recommendations. License identifiers are preliminary and must be checked at a pinned upstream revision. No star counts or adoption claims have been verified.

providers.name: ALTCHA
providers.privacy: No camera or microphone needed; resource use must be measured.
providers.accessibility: Provide a non-compute fallback for low-power devices.
providers.notes: Core proof-of-work is computational cost, not proof of a unique or present human.

providers.name: Cap
providers.privacy: Review instrumentation signals and retention.
providers.accessibility: Evaluate keyboard and assistive technology behavior.
providers.notes: Canonical repository and standalone server compatibility require live confirmation.

providers.name: mCaptcha
providers.privacy: Privacy-oriented deployment; review logs.
providers.accessibility: Measure mobile compute cost and alternatives.
providers.notes: AGPL obligations need review before distribution or hosted modifications.

providers.name: Anubis
providers.privacy: Review proxy access logs.
providers.accessibility: Provide a route for browsers without supported JavaScript.
providers.notes: Scraper defense at the edge, not a form widget or proof of humanity.

providers.name: VAPTCHA
providers.privacy: Vendor processing and region must be assessed.
providers.accessibility: Require a documented fallback.
providers.notes: Candidate vendor; no server adapter implemented.

providers.name: dchest/captcha
providers.privacy: Self-hosted image/audio generation.
providers.accessibility: Audio is an alternative modality, not complete accessibility coverage.
providers.notes: Go image/audio CAPTCHA library; no modern bot resistance claim.

providers.name: base64Captcha
providers.privacy: Self-hosted generated challenge assets.
providers.accessibility: Evaluate each driver separately.
providers.notes: Go generators; production replay and rate limits remain integrator responsibilities.

providers.name: Tianai CAPTCHA
providers.privacy: Review behavior telemetry before deployment.
providers.accessibility: Pointer puzzles need an equivalent accessible route.
providers.notes: Java interaction CAPTCHA candidate; license and active maintenance need live checks.

providers.name: AJ-Captcha
providers.privacy: Self-hosting does not remove behavioral data obligations.
providers.accessibility: Provide keyboard/nonvisual alternatives.
providers.notes: Java slider and point-selection CAPTCHA candidate.

providers.name: SimpleCaptcha
providers.privacy: Python-generated challenge assets can stay on your server.
providers.accessibility: Audio and image both need usability testing.
providers.notes: Python library, not an adaptive risk platform.

providers.name: django-simple-captcha
providers.privacy: Review challenge expiry, session, and storage settings.
providers.accessibility: Optional audio requires dependency and usability checks.
providers.notes: Django integration candidate; no agent resistance assertion.

providers.name: svg-captcha
providers.privacy: Generated SVG can remain local.
providers.accessibility: Visual text challenges require an accessible alternative.
providers.notes: Library only; easy integration does not imply effectiveness against OCR/VLMs.

providers.name: Gregwar/Captcha
providers.privacy: Generated assets can remain local.
providers.accessibility: Require an alternative to image text recognition.
providers.notes: PHP image CAPTCHA generator; evaluate modern solver success before recommending.

providers.name: Securimage
providers.privacy: Review server-side session and audio retention.
providers.accessibility: Test real assistive technology and language coverage.
providers.notes: PHP CAPTCHA candidate; maintenance and package integrity must be checked.

providers.name: FingerprintJS BotD
providers.privacy: Document detected signals and retention.
providers.accessibility: No puzzle alone; browser support can cause exclusion.
providers.notes: Browser automation signal library, not a standalone verification authority.

providers.name: FingerprintJS
providers.privacy: Device fingerprinting can be personal data; explicit review required.
providers.accessibility: Do not penalize assistive browsers solely on unusual signals.
providers.notes: Open-source and commercial product licenses/capabilities differ; verify current license.

providers.name: CreepJS
providers.privacy: Research fingerprinting can be invasive; opt-in lab use first.
providers.accessibility: Atypical browser signals are not proof of automation.
providers.notes: Research signal source; do not present as CAPTCHA or production risk verdict.

providers.name: Cerberus
providers.privacy: Review edge logs and any browser instrumentation.
providers.accessibility: Review JavaScript/compute dependencies.
providers.notes: Proof-of-work protection candidate; current project scope must be confirmed.

providers.name: LibreCaptcha
providers.privacy: Confirm current repository and deployed data flow.
providers.accessibility: Require modality alternatives.
providers.notes: Discovery candidate only: repository identity and maintenance unverified.

providers.name: Friendly Captcha
providers.privacy: Separate open widget from commercial service processing.
providers.accessibility: Evaluate low-power clients and supported fallback.
providers.notes: Versioned open client/server feature and license boundaries require confirmation.

providers.name: Cloudflare Turnstile
providers.privacy: Disclose vendor processing and assess jurisdiction.
providers.accessibility: Use vendor accessibility documentation plus local testing.
providers.notes: Use official Siteverify; hostname/action, TTL, and one-time use are essential.

providers.name: Google reCAPTCHA
providers.privacy: Assess vendor data processing and consent requirements.
providers.accessibility: Offer alternatives when image/audio challenges fail.
providers.notes: Enterprise assessments and classic APIs have different verification contracts.

providers.name: hCaptcha
providers.privacy: Assess DPA, telemetry, and regional settings.
providers.accessibility: Verify the supported accessibility route.
providers.notes: Official siteverify and enterprise signals; do not copy challenge engine.

providers.name: Arkose Labs
providers.privacy: Assess behavioral telemetry and contractual terms.
providers.accessibility: Confirm accessible challenge and support paths.
providers.notes: Official Verify API only; game mechanics do not independently prove humanity.

providers.name: GeeTest
providers.privacy: Review cross-border processing and telemetry.
providers.accessibility: Require accessible fallback for pointer/visual tasks.
providers.notes: Use documented vendor protocol; license does not permit engine extraction.

providers.name: AWS Rekognition Face Liveness
providers.privacy: Explicit opt-in, region, retention, biometric impact review.
providers.accessibility: Camera-free equivalent path required; never default for ordinary forms.
providers.notes: Liveness confidence is probabilistic; it is not identity or uniqueness.

providers.name: FaceTec
providers.privacy: Biometric templates and retention require strict governance.
providers.accessibility: Provide non-biometric alternatives.
providers.notes: Face matching is a separate configured capability from live presence.

providers.name: iProov
providers.privacy: Opt-in biometric processing; check regional and retention terms.
providers.accessibility: Consider photosensitivity, camera quality, and alternative routes.
providers.notes: Product claims need independent PAD evaluation and versioned evidence.

providers.name: Pindrop
providers.privacy: Voice may be sensitive personal data; minimize collection.
providers.accessibility: Provide alternatives for speech/hearing disabilities and noisy contexts.
providers.notes: Voice liveness does not prove unique personhood or account ownership.

providers.name: World ID
providers.privacy: Review credential issuer, unlinkability, enrollment and region constraints.
providers.accessibility: Enrollment availability can exclude people; provide alternatives.
providers.notes: Credential type determines assurance; never equate every credential with uniqueness.

providers.name: Semaphore
providers.privacy: Anonymous membership can reduce disclosure; enrollment still matters.
providers.accessibility: No puzzle, but enrollment must be accessible.
providers.notes: Proves membership/nullifier constraints, not humanity of arbitrary group entrants.

providers.name: WebAuthn / passkeys
providers.privacy: Device biometric need not leave the authenticator.
providers.accessibility: Support recovery and multiple authenticators.
providers.notes: User verification authenticates account/device continuity, not initial humanity.

providers.name: SimpleWebAuthn
providers.privacy: Store public keys and minimal account metadata.
providers.accessibility: Provide enrollment/recovery alternatives.
providers.notes: Integration building block for a trusted-account route, not CAPTCHA replacement evidence.

providers.name: Kechap interaction replay
providers.privacy: Minimize event streams; do not collect raw biometrics.
providers.accessibility: Keyboard and non-cognitive routes need independent evaluation.
providers.notes: Research only until benchmarked; server replay prevents forged outcomes but does not prove human origin.
